news.summary: Energy is back on the front page as millions of Europeans weigh heating against groceries, politicians argue over subsidies and diesel supply talks between Brussels and Washington highlight how fragile fuel flows can be. That mix of stress and policy support is reshaping where capital could be hurt or helped. This article walks through three European renewable energy and grid infrastructure stocks
